title: Programiz: Count Number of Each Vowel
description: Given string `s`, count the occurrences of each vowel 'a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u' (case-insensitive). Return dictionary with keys 'a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u' mapped to their counts.

input.s: Hello, have you tried our tutorial section yet?

explanation: Tracks frequency of each vowel key in O(N) time.
